Firewood From Our Own Auburn Township Yard Since 1982

Auburn Township is home base — the same yard the Roubic family has worked from since 1982. Our firewood isn't bought in and resold; it's bucked and split from the tree removals and trimmings our own crews perform across NE Ohio, then stacked to season on the yard.

Because Auburn Township is where the wood lives, local orders travel the shortest possible distance — many neighbors simply pick up a face cord straight from the yard. Mixed hardwood is standard: oak, maple, ash, beech, and elm, seasoned 6–12 months and moisture-tested before it ever leaves.

Locally Sourced, EAB-Quarantine-Compliant Firewood

NE Ohio sits inside the Emerald Ash Borer quarantine, so where your firewood comes from actually matters. Every cord Roubic delivers is sourced from our own tree work and split right here on the Auburn Township yard — there is no out-of-quarantine transport, and the provenance is traceable from tree to delivery.

The wood is seasoned 6–12 months and moisture-tested under 20% before it leaves the yard, so it lights cleanly, burns hot, and keeps creosote buildup low. Green, unseasoned wood is never sold.

What Happens If You Wait

The Cost of Ordering Firewood Late — Auburn Township Context

Three ways waiting on firewood turns into a colder, more expensive winter.

Seasoned Wood Sells Out

Properly seasoned hardwood takes 6–12 months to be ready. When demand spikes at the first cold snap, the well-seasoned stock is the first to go — order-ahead households get the dry wood.

Burning Green Wood

Grabbing unseasoned wood in a pinch means poor heat, hard lighting, and heavy creosote buildup in the flue — a real chimney-fire risk. Roubic won't sell green wood for exactly this reason.

Out-of-Quarantine Firewood

Moving non-compliant firewood into or around the EAB quarantine zone spreads the pest and can carry penalties. Locally sourced, traceable wood keeps you clean and keeps the local canopy safer.

Common Auburn Township Firewood Questions

Auburn Township Firewood Delivery FAQ

Six things Auburn Township homeowners want to know before ordering.

How much is a cord of firewood delivered to Auburn Township?
Per-cord firewood pricing is delivery-distance sensitive, and Auburn Township is the yard itself — the shortest haul we run. Call {{global.phone}} for current per-cord pricing on face, half, and full cords. The one fixed add-on is stacked delivery at $40–$80 per cord depending on complexity; a dumped load carries no stacking fee.
Is the firewood Roubic delivers seasoned?
Yes. All wood is seasoned 6–12 months on the Auburn Township yard and moisture-tested under 20% before it leaves. Seasoned wood lights cleanly, burns hot, and produces minimal creosote. Green, unseasoned wood is never sold.
Where does Roubic's firewood come from?
All firewood is locally sourced from Roubic's own NE Ohio tree work — bucked and split on the Auburn Township yard from removals and trimmings our crews performed. There is no out-of-quarantine transport, full Emerald Ash Borer (EAB) compliance, and traceable provenance from tree to delivery.
What cord sizes can I order in Auburn Township?
Roubic delivers by face cord (1/3 cord — the typical residential order), half cord, and full cord (4' × 4' × 8', sized for heavy-use households). The standard mix is hardwood — oak, maple, ash, beech, and elm. Bulk and recurring orders qualify for a discount.
Does Roubic stack firewood at delivery?
Stacked delivery is available for an additional fee — typically $40–$80 per cord depending on complexity (single row, multi-row, or woodshed loading). Many homeowners save money by handling stacking themselves; in that case Roubic simply dumps the load in your designated spot.
Is Roubic licensed and insured for firewood delivery in Auburn Township?
Yes — Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC carries full general liability and workers-compensation insurance, with certificates available on request. The family has run continuous coverage since 1982 and holds a 5.0 rating across Google reviews.
